meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 技能装上后,Claude 在你说要检查界面时,会先抓取网页或终端界面的截图证据,再用脚本算出像素差异,然后派两个只读评审员分别检查设计系统/功能完整性和视觉保真/CJK 文本,最后给出通过或不通过的结论。
howto.when: 在构建或修改任何 UI 之后、被问到页面或组件是否正常时触发;也会在提到“视觉 QA”“截图对比”“UI 看起来不对”等触发词时接管。

say.text: 我刚改了登录页,请做一次视觉 QA。
say.note: 会抓取截图并派两个评审员检查。

say.text: 对照这张设计稿,检查当前页面是否一致。
say.note: 会按参考图逐页比对像素。

say.text: 检查这个 TUI 的边框是否对齐,有没有中文截断。
say.note: 会生成终端截图并检查宽字符列。

howto.what_en: When asked to check a UI, Claude captures screenshots of web/TUI, computes pixel diffs, dispatches two read-only reviewers (design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK), then gives a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after building or changing any UI, when asked if a page/component/TUI looks right, or when keywords like visual QA, screenshot diff, UI looks wrong, etc. are mentioned.

say_en.text: I just changed the login page, please do a visual QA.
Compare this design mock against the current page for fidelity.
Check this TUI for border alignment and CJK text clipping.
say_en.note: Captures terminal render and checks wide-char columns.
